summary: Diff adds chase/target utility functions and updates LiveScoringPage and MatchSummaryPage to use them. Some acceptance-criteria details (toast content, blocking further scoring, and navigation behavior) are not directly verifiable from the truncated code shown. Diff also includes several unrelated frontend enhancements/routes not requested in the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: During second innings scoring, as soon as the second innings total runs becomes >= target, the app shows an English success toast indicating the match is won and by which team.
missing_requirements.reason: LiveScoringPage imports `toast`, computes `chaseAchieved`, and adds `chaseWonToastShown` state, but the provided truncated snippet does not show any effect/handler that fires a success toast containing the winning team name.

missing_requirements.requirement: After the chase is achieved, the Live Scoring controls no longer allow recording additional balls for that match (either disabled or blocked with an English message).
missing_requirements.reason: The truncated LiveScoringPage snippet does not show any conditional disabling/blocking of ball-recording controls based on `chaseAchieved`.

missing_requirements.requirement: After the chase is achieved, the app navigates to the Match Summary screen for the match (without getting stuck on the Live Scoring page).
missing_requirements.reason: Navigation behavior on chase completion is claimed in the file summary, but the truncated LiveScoringPage code excerpt does not show a `navigate` call tied to `chaseAchieved`.

missing_requirements.requirement: The winner heading on MatchSummaryPage remains correct for win/lose/tie outcomes and is consistent with the new result sentence.
missing_requirements.reason: MatchSummaryPage winner determination logic is truncated mid-expression, so correctness/consistency with tie outcome cannot be verified from the provided diff excerpt.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a new match statistics route/view and statistics navigation not requested by REQ-46/47/48.
hallucinated_features.reason: Frontend summaries mention a "new match statistics route" in App.tsx and statistics navigation from summary pages, which is outside the BuildRequest scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Connectivity probing improvements and detailed offline/online reason reporting not requested by the BuildRequest.
hallucinated_features.reason: Frontend summaries describe expanded backend health checks and connectivity reasons; BuildRequest is focused on chase/target display and auto-win behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: Additional hardening/guards preventing ball recording when innings is complete due to overs limit (legal deliveries only) beyond the chase-win requirement.
hallucinated_features.reason: Frontend summaries mention hardened ball recording and local store integrity guards for overs completion; REQ-47 only specifies blocking after chase achieved (target reached).

hallucinated_features.description: Multiple unrelated mobile responsiveness/theme/CSS adjustments not requested by the BuildRequest.
hallucinated_features.reason: Frontend summaries mention global style changes (OKLCH color system, mobile-safety CSS, touch target sizing) not part of REQ-46/47/48.
